title: Pan-Seared Pork Dumplings
description: Crispy pan-seared pork dumplings with a gooey filling for a delicious keto dinner.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Place a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface.
Place a tablespoon of gooey filling in the center of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Add dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
